spanish: Siete días expiarás sobre el altar, y lo santificarás, y será el altar santo de santos; todo el tocante en el altar se santificará.

findings.issue: Qal imperfect 3ms is stative (shall be holy). 'se santificará' is the passive/reflexive of the factitive and changes the stem force.

notes: Remaining clauses match the packet in number, person, participants, and the piel factitive.
